content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I uploaded my program to the module using Wi-Fi for the first time with the 7th series controller. I am interested in restricting IP changes, possibly by using password protection.
Could you please explain how to achieve this?
If you correctly configure your WLAN router, connecting to the [product_name] module such as [version_no] over Wi-Fi is straightforward.
You are correct—the issue was actually related to the router configuration. The network structure can be found in the attached file.

I have worked on a similar wireless network, but used a different controller ([version_no]). The key step is performing initial configuration and access to both the access point and client using an Ethernet cable. Afterwards, everything operates smoothly wirelessly, except if you restore factory settings on either device.
Having an Ethernet port on the 7th series controller is beneficial for setup and operation.

analysis.insight_summary: Users shared their experiences configuring controllers over Wi-Fi. The main consideration is that initial setup requires an Ethernet cable to properly configure wireless settings for access points and clients. After setup, wireless operation is reliable unless factory settings are restored. The Ethernet port is appreciated for simplifying the setup.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward Wi-Fi connectivity to their controller after the initial setup, with the possibility to restrict network changes (such as IP modifications) via password protection. Simplicity in setup and dependable wireless performance are valued.
pain_keywords: risk of losing settings after factory reset
